issues.title: [CI Failure]: tests/kernels/moe/test_deepep_moe.py SIGSEGV on ROCm, drop the two teardown workarounds once the image ships rocm-systems#6942
issues.author: stefankoncarevic
issues.body_head:
### Name of failing test

tests/kernels/moe/test_deepep_moe.py::test_deep_ep_moe

### Basic information

- [ ] Flaky test
- [x] Can reproduce locally
- [x] Caused by external libraries (e.g. bug in `transformers`)

### 🧪 Describe the failing test

The test passes today only because two workarounds are in tree, and this issue tracks
removing them.

Without them, every high-throughput variant dies with SIGSEGV, 28 of 28, while every
low-latency variant passes. The test body completes and the process dies during teardown
inside the ROCm HSA runtime, where AqlQueue's destructor writes to signals whose backing
memory has already been unmapped. That path is only reached while rocprofiler-sdk is
attached, which recent torch builds do implicitly. It reproduces with a plain HIP program
under rocprofv3, with no torch, DeepEP or vLLM involved.

The workarounds to remove, both guarded by current_platform.is_rocm():

1. tests/kernels/moe/test_deepep_moe.py sets ROCPROFILER_REGISTER_ENABLED=0 so the spawned
   workers do not inherit the profiler (#51173).
2. tests/kernels/moe/parallel_utils.py leaves the worker through os._exit after destroying
   the process group (#51174).

The defect is fixed upstream in https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-systems/pull/6942. Once a CI
base image ships a ROCm build containing it, drop both and confirm with

    pytest -v -s tests/kernels/moe/test_deepep_moe.py

which should stay at 56 passed.

### 📝 History of failing test

Not a vLLM regression. It appeared without any change on the vLLM side, once torch builds
began attaching rocprofiler-sdk implicitly, and it was masked on 5 Aug 2026 by #51173 and
#51174, so Buildkite shows the test green from then on.

### CC List.

@AndreasKaratzas @Rohan138

issues.title: [CI Failure]: test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8 — "invalid argument for fmha_fwd" on MI300X
issues.author: vhagor
issues.body_head:
### Name of failing test

tests/kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8

### Basic information

- [ ] Flaky test
- [ ] Can reproduce locally
- [ ] Caused by external libraries (e.g. bug in `transformers`)

### 🧪 Describe the failing test

## [CI Failure]: test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8 — "invalid argument for fmha_fwd" on MI300X

### Name of failing test

`tests/kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8`

### Basic information

- [x] Flaky test (fails on the AMD image built for 2026-08-05; the same shard was green on 2026-08-03)
- [x] Can reproduce locally on MI300X (`gfx942`) with the current AMD CI image
- [x] Caused by external libraries (likely AITER / composable_kernel; not yet confirmed upstream)

### 🧪 Describe the failing test

`amd-kernels-attention-test-1-mi300-1` fails with `5 failed, 1537 passed, 1781 skipped`. All 5 failures are the same test, same error:

```text
FAILED kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8[dtype0-64-var_seq_len0] - RuntimeError: invalid argument for fmha_fwd
FAILED kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8[dtype1-64-var_seq_len1] - RuntimeError: invalid argument for fmha_fwd
FAILED kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8[dtype1-72-var_seq_len0] - RuntimeError: invalid argument for fmha_fwd
FAILED kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8[dtype1-72-var_seq_len1] - RuntimeError: invalid argument for fmha_fwd
FAILED kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8[dtype1-80-var_seq_len0] - RuntimeError: invalid argument for fmha_fwd
```

Only 5 of the 12 parametrizations fail (`dtype ∈ {bfloat16, half}` × `head_size ∈ {64,72,80}` × `var_seq_len ∈ {[128,193],[256,384,511]}`); the rest pass, and the sibling job `amd-kernels-attention-test-2-mi300-1` passes.

The test was added in #49937 ([ROCm] Add AITER FP8 ViT encoder attention, merged 2026-07-30).

### 📝 Error traceback

The error is raised inside AITER's CK JIT dispatch, not in vLLM Python code:

```text
MMEncoderAttention.forward_cuda
  → _forward_aiter_fp8                        (vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mm_encoder_attention.py:755)
  → vit_aiter_fp8_attn_wrapper               (vllm/v1/attention/ops/vit_attn_wrappers.py:131)
  → torch.ops.vllm.aiter_fp8_attn_wrapper    (vllm/_aiter_ops.py:1486)
  → aiter.flash_attn_varlen_fp8_pertensor_func   (aiter/ops/mha.py:4081)
  → _flash_attn_varlen_forward → mha_varlen_fwd  (aiter/ops/mha.py:3011)
       md_name = mha_varlen_fwd_fp8bf16_nlogits_nbias_nmask_nlse_ndropout_nskip_pertensor
       blob_gen_cmd = .../composable_kernel/example/ck_tile/01_fmha/generate.py -d fwd_splitkv --receipt 200 ...

E   RuntimeError: invalid argument for fmha_fwd
aiter/jit/core.py:1780: RuntimeError
```

The CK module compiles (the first case spends ~80s in JIT), but at launch the runtime arguments match no compiled `fmha_fwd` instance, so CK rejects the call.

### 📄 Full logs / build

- Failing job: [vllm/ci #82340 · amd-kernels-attention-test-1-mi300-1](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/82340#019fd00c-0c67-489b-9739-f2e86a29ec33) (exit status 1)
- Passing baseline (same shard, `main`, 2026-08-03): [vllm/ci #82016](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/82016#019fc832-d562-49b2-a427-59f07268889b) — `1542 passed, 0 failed`
- Retried once; failure reproduces (not a within-run flake).

### 🔁 Regression evidence (image, not code)

| | `main` #82016 (2026-08-03) | run #82340 (2026-08-05) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shard | 3314 items | 3314 items |
| `aiter_fp8` cases reached | same 5 | same 5 |
| Result | **1542 passed, 0 failed** | **5 failed** |
| First case JIT time | 80.01 s | 79.65 s |
| Arch | MI300X / `gfx942` | MI300X / `gfx942` |

Same test code, same parametrizations, same hardware — only the build date differs, which points at the AMD test image / AITER-CK kernel set rather than a vLLM change. It surfaced on a PR that touches no ROCm / AITER / ViT / MMEncoder code.

### 🖥️ Environment

- **Hardware:** AMD Instinct MI300X (`gfx942`)
- **CI job:** `amd-kernels-attention-test-1-mi300-1`
- **Image pins** (`docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base`): `BASE_IMAGE=rocm/dev-ubuntu-22.04:7.2.3-complete`, `AITER_BRANCH=v0.1.19`, `PYTORCH_BRANCH=d0c8b1f3` (release/2.11), `TRITON_BRANCH=0f380657`, `FA_BRANCH=0e60e394`
- **vLLM commit under test:** `f27555f2d8` (merge of `main` into a PR branch that does not modify ROCm code)

### 🔁 Reproduction

```bash
pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_mha_attn.py::test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8 -v
# on MI300X (gfx942) with the current AMD CI image
```

### Notes

- Latest `main` build [#82449](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/82449) had just reached this test when this issue was filed; result pending. If it is also red, the regression is confirmed on `main`, independent of any PR. cc @vllm-project/rocm maintainers of #49937.


### 📝 History of failing test

### 🕰️ History of failing test

| Date | Build / ref | Job | `aiter_fp8` outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-07-30 | #49937 merged | — | Test introduced (`test_mha_attn_varlen_forward_aiter_fp8`) |
| 2026-07-30 | #49361 merged | — | `AITER_BRANCH` pinned to `v0.1.19` in `docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base` |
| 2026-08-03 | [`main` #82016](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/82016#019fc832-d562-49b2-a427-59f07268889b) | `amd-kernels-attention-test-1-mi300-1` | ✅ `1542 passed, 0 failed` (all 12 params pass) |
| 2026-08-05 | [PR #82340](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/82340#019fd00c-0c67-489b-9739-f2e86a29ec33) | `amd-kernels-attention-test-1-mi300-1` | ❌ `5 failed` — `invalid argument for fmha_fwd` |
| 2026-08-05 | PR #82340 (retry) | same | ❌ reproduces (not a within-run flake) |
| 2026-08-05 | [`main` #82449](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/82449#019fd032-5f84-44c3-a26f-b31f2e4f0b69) | same | ⏳ in progress at time of filing |

**Observations**

- The test passed cleanly on `main` as recently as **2026-08-03** and started failing on **2026-08-05**, so the flip is in that 2-day window.
- No code in the failing path changed in that window: the test file (#49937) and `vllm/_aiter_ops.py` were last touched on 2026-07-30, and the `docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base` pins (`AITER_BRANCH=v0.1.19`, `PYTORCH_BRANCH`, `TRITON_BRANCH`, `FA_BRANCH`) were last modified on 2026-07-30. This is consistent with the AMD base image being **rebuilt** (regenerating the composable_kernel `fwd_splitkv` blob set) rather than any source change.
- First observed failing: **2026-08-05, build #82340**. First observed passing: **2026-08-03, build #82016**.
- The failure is a stable subset (5 of 12 parametrizations), not intermittent across parametrizations within a run.


### CC List.

_No response_

issues.title: [AMD][CI Failure][Tracker] Static dashboard tracker for current CI failures
issues.author: AndreasKaratzas
issues.body_head:
This is the single dashboard-managed umbrella issue for current AMD CI failures tracked by `AndreasKaratzas/vllm-ci-dashboard`.

## Rules
- The dashboard automation updates only one managed comment on this issue.
- The dashboard automation must not create or modify any other `vllm-project/vllm` issues.
- Engineers should open separate manual issues when they pick up a specific failure to work on.
- Those manual issues can move through [project #39](https://github.com/orgs/vllm-project/projects/39) and be referenced by the dashboard, but they are not edited by the dashboard automation.

## Engineer workflow
- Check the managed comment on this issue for the latest failing groups.
- Open a separate issue for any failure you pick up.
- Move that separate issue through the appropriate [project #39](https://github.com/orgs/vllm-project/projects/39) column and assign an owner there.

## Ownership
- Dashboard owner: `@AndreasKaratzas`
- Repo: `AndreasKaratzas/vllm-ci-dashboard`
